name: gramicidin + neomycin + polymyxin b
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Neomycin and polymyxin B sulfates and gramicidin ophthalmic solution is indicated for the topical treatment of superficial infections of the external eye and its adnexa caused by susceptible bacteria. Such infections encompass conjunctivitis, keratitis and keratoconjunctivitis, blepharitis and blepharoconjunctivitis.
pediatric: Pediatric Use Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS This product is contraindicated in those persons who have shown hypersensitivity to any of its components.

src.label: NEOMYCIN AND POLYMYXIN B SULFATES AND GRAMICIDIN
